files.about: Requirements R1-R18 (0.2 adds event shards, session replay, experiments and surveys) with acceptance checks, scope and definition of done.

The normative SDK wire format: capture routes, body decoding, tokens, timestamps, v1 capture, persons and merges, feature flags, remote config, session recording snapshots, surveys, exposure events, error codes.
Worked examples for decoding, tokens, timestamps, distinct ids, flag hashing and matching, capture responses and person scenarios.
Stack, storage and event-shard decisions, Cloudflare config, deploy and upgrade, data model, ingestion, query semantics, replay, experiment statistics, surveys, owner API, screens, tests and limits.
Build order, each step with a check.
How the protocol was established with REA (0.1 and 0.2 captures, conformance runs), evidence and obligation ledgers, unknowns, licensing and choices.

commands: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local

changelog.note: Session replay (posthog-js recorder, R2 chunks, rrweb-player), experiments (multivariate flags, Bayesian results), surveys (posthog-js /api/surveys, results) and time-sharded event storage past 10 GB per project with exact counts. Upgrades a 0.1 instance in place.
posthog-js is credited with its actual licence (Apache-2.0 and MIT). The e2e flag check waits for the flags reload after identify, so it also passes against a deployed instance over the network.
